liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Terrapin Station** (2 reviews): Attendee says the Scarlet, Fire, Playin, Dark Star, Terrapin run left the crowd stunned leaving the Spectrum; Coming out of Terrapin, Vince plays a wordless ballad at the start of the Drumz file while the band quiets around him [11][15]
- **Tubular Bells jam** (2 reviews): Reviewer believes the tracks are out of order: the Tubular Bells jam belongs after Space, not after Terrapin; Terrapin's closing jam hints at the Tubular Bells theme and is spliced with a clearer post-drums Tubular Bells jam [8][9]
- **Hell in a Bucket** (1 review): High-energy opener; Bobby's falsetto ending returned after throat polyps had hampered it for most of the year [17]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Jerry's new guitar has a clean tone but seems to lack the juice to go into overdrive here [17]
- **I Fought The Law** (1 review): Reviewer was disappointed by the brief, half-hearted encore after such inspired second-set jamming [18]

## Setlist highlights

- **Tubular Bells jam**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-09-13.152496.nak300-cousinit.shnf** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 147 min [1]
- **gd93-09-13.sbd.barbella.7361.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 143 min; rated 4.17/5 by 6 [2]
- **gd1993-09-13.schoeps.Litzenberger.85991.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 154 min; rated 3/5 by 2 [4]. Said about its sound: Uploader's own I Fought The Law has many dropouts and glitches, so the encore was patched from a clone [4]
- **gd93-09-13.sbd.miller-wiley.12096.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 143 min; rated 4.24/5 by 37 [5]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has Garcia's guitar forward and twangy; reviewer ranks the sound quality among the best downloaded [13]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended the show and names the correct track order after Terrapin, using disc 2 and disc 3 file numbers [10]
- Reviewer says the previous night in Philadelphia was a warm-up, and this second night felt special on entering the Spectrum [7]
- Reviewer finds the first set merely good, and considers the second-set opening segue the only essential part [12]
- Uploader preferred the sound of the other audience recording that circulates, though this one differs from it [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-09-13.152496.nak300-cousinit.shnf**: taped by MDAT>SHN Conversion by Cousinit  MAC>SHN Conversion by Cousinit; source: Source: Cousinit's Denon DTR80P DAT Deck w/ Nak 300 Shotguns>MDAT>WAV>SHN Patch Source: Cousinit's Sony D6 Deck w/ Nak 300 Shotguns>MAC>DAT>WAV>SHN [1]. Also: Audience recording using a Nak 300 taper; a patch source supplies the end of Terrapin through I Fought The Law [1]
- **gd93-09-13.sbd.barbella.7361.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> DAT> CM> DAT> CD [2]. Also: Soundboard transfer chain: SB to DAT to CM to DAT to CD, via Charlie Miller, Chris Frisco and Steve Barbella [2]
- **gd1993-09-13.schoeps.Litzenberger.85991.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK4's>Reutelhuber Preamp>Casio DA-7 from Section 102 Row 14 [4]
- **gd93-09-13.sbd.miller-wiley.12096.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> DAT> CM> DAT> CDR [5]. Also: This copy comes from David Gan's GD Hour broadcast source, and the reviewer hopes a correct second set gets uploaded [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead The Spectrum - September 14, 1993](https://www.dead.net/show/september-14-1993) [24]
- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead Traders Vault 9/13/1993 THE SPECTRUM SBD Playn DarkStar Terrapin | #4671434616](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-traders-vault-13-1993-4671434616) [25]
- Poster by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1993-09-13 The Spectrum, Philadelphia, PA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1993-09-13-the-spectrum-philadelphia-pa-usa/) [26]
